mechanism: Nicotine increases sympathomimetic activity and blood pressure, potentially counteracting the antihypertensive effects of ramipril (ACE inhibitor), while ramipril may increase potassium levels that nicotine could further elevate through catecholamine release.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely in patients using nicotine products (smoking, patches, gum); counsel on smoking cessation as nicotine reduces ramipril efficacy and increases cardiovascular risk.
